mapper.select: SELECT ar.agent_type AS agentType, COUNT(ar.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, AVG(ar.time_taken) AS avgTimeTakenMs FROM agent_run ar WHERE ar.project_id = #{projectId} AND ar.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ar.agent_type ORDER BY totalCount DESC
